CardDescription.DefaultText:
We shall make it yours forever. A small and faithful rot.

It will linger at your side and keep the hungrier sicknesses from finding a home within you.
CardDescription.Text: 我们将使其永属汝身——一小簇忠腐，常伴不离。\n\n它将傍汝左右，令诸般贪疾无以寓于汝体。
